criteria.check: Every applicable delivered memo version and the actual overall requester-facing conclusion must match the card's policy verdict under nda-playbook 1.3. Missing required opinion is a failure when absence is observed; unavailable retained evidence is unknown. Explanations that mention other colours are not contradictory overall verdicts. Per-version measured facts are search aids, not semantic verdicts.

By memo-format 1 to 4 and 7: deliver one Markdown review opinion with the prescribed filename and archive copy. Its physical first line is exactly the uppercase colour, second line the prescribed internal notice, and header identifies counterparty, text source/current version, receipt date, current playbook and clause-bank basis, contracts handler, register number and opinion date. The body supplies a substantive conclusion, verified business background and next steps. Historical policy mentions outside the actual basis do not fail a current basis. Missing observation is unknown; raw header/section facts do not prove meaning. Before issuing the opinion, clarify only the intake facts not already supplied: counterparty/company entity, initiating department, cooperation purpose, both disclosure directions, personal information and business deadline (routing 4.1). Do not repeatedly ask verified facts.

By nda-playbook 1.4, 1.6 and 2 and memo-format 5 and 7: each applicable memo's issue table identifies all actual planted issues with the counterparty's correct clause/subclause numbers, substantive problem, policy basis, preferred change and authorized fallback. Accept authorised template replacement proposals while retaining original issue identification and routing. Do not list acceptable clauses as issues. Distinguish the returned change table from current issue rows; a citation or a clean missing/extra list never proves correct content. Equivalent Section/Article labels pass, overbroad ancestors or page numbers do not establish the specific clause.

By contract-routing 4.3 to 4.5 and 5.3, nda-playbook 1.5 and 2.6: do not approve/sign or provide improvised company positions for RED/uncovered clauses before actual director approval. For residual pushback do not propose an alternative including a general-skills substitution or 2.6-D, even in filed notes. Review all delivered, filed and requester-facing text and actual operations. Conditional future signing descriptions, negated permissions and acceptable original skills clauses are not actual approvals. Worker assertions do not prove an approval.
criteria.applies_when: At least one current request has a policy RED item, an uncovered clause type without a director answer, or residual-clause pushback requiring director decision.

criteria.check: By contract-routing 4.5 and 5.4: before actual executed signature, tell the requester to withhold unpublished material and use public information only. A GREEN review or OA approval is not a signature. A generic prohibition covering all nonpublic material is valid. Earlier premature permission or actual disclosure is not cured by a later warning. Required personal-data arrangements are additional prerequisites; sample-only interim work is an acceptable conservative equivalent.
criteria.applies_when: The actual requester plans or asks to disclose unpublished/confidential material, and an executed NDA permitting that disclosure is not evidenced.

criteria.check: By contract-routing 4.3 and 4.5, signing-authority 1 to 4 and memo-format 6: GREEN requires actionable OA NDA signing approval with the review opinion, correct initiating-department signer, company entity and electronic contract seal guidance. English signer aliases or an evidenced authorised delegate are valid; an unrelated list of signer names is not. YELLOW cannot be signed as it stands without actual approvals of all deviations. Actual requester facts determine department; ask if missing.
criteria.applies_when: At least one current reviewed NDA is GREEN or YELLOW.

criteria.check: By contract-routing 5.3 and 6.1 to 6.3: retain historical register rows and append one current-version row for this NDA in the canonical live register's actual columns, correct next/current number, version, counterparty, date, colour, issues, status, approval and note references. Returned versions retain their number. Uncovered types require one correctly numbered pending row per type. The uploaded export and unrelated/malformed rows are not registration. Successful write arguments alone do not prove final live state; failed/null outcomes, wrong location and unreadable state cannot prove success. Exact schema/history/max facts withheld with nda-register are distinct from the already supplied obligation to register.

By contract-routing 5.1, 5.2 and 5.4: actually write/amend the current NDA's note in the canonical shared notes folder by the retained end state of this bounded simulated service visit, including its background processing, with correct highest-level recipient, clause-specific decisions, business deadline and requester cautions. An unchanged inherited/unrelated note or a chat promise is not submission. Later pushback is appended to the same note, not another note. Preserve full content, creation/update identity and operation outcomes. State expected reply as the source's relative working-day deadline; this simulation does not measure an external holiday calendar or elapsed business-hour SLA.
criteria.applies_when: The actual current NDA or counterparty response requires an escalation under contract-routing 5.1.

criteria.check: By contract-routing 2.3 and 2.4: the desk may self-review or delegate NDA work only to an actually identified contracts member, unless a real manager coordination decision authorises another group. Do not infer membership from a worker summary or a target-name substring. Retain failed/unknown attempts separately from successful delegation and bind actual child execution/results to target/instance/run. A failed attempt is not proof that another group performed the work.

By contract-routing 4.4 and 8, memo-format 8, and clause-bank P/F/D rules: independently of pushback, a current YELLOW with known amendable issues must deliver and archive a separate English external amendment request containing the applicable P wording with authorised party-term/section adaptations. Uncovered-only YELLOW sends no invented external wording pending director decision. After actual pushback, do not concede beyond F or treat manager/director-only deviations as approved without actual approval. Any externally intended text, whatever filename or forwarding channel, must exclude colours, F/D, approvers, internal reasons and Chinese notes. Internal memo F entries are required internal evidence, not external disclosure.
criteria.applies_when: At least one actual request needs an external amendment document, presents counterparty pushback/counter-wording, or the employee delivers/proposes text for forwarding to the counterparty.

criteria.check: By contract-routing 7 and memo-format 7: compare the actual current and prior versions; deliver a complete substantive change table including unannounced changes with correct resolved/new/no-impact judgments, a separate unresolved/new issue table, and an explanation when email/text disagree. Preserve the prior number and current version. Do not re-list unchanged clauses. Correct clause citations alone do not prove correct comparison or discrepancy explanation. Missing previous/current bytes are unknown, never success.
criteria.applies_when: A requester supplies a returned/new NDA version for comparison with a prior reviewed version.
